visualCharacteristics.purpose: Get-the-app panel: heading, device picker and Get the app button over consent copy, beside a QR-code/phone image
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two halves side by side from 900px (image cell may sit on either side); stacked below with the image on top. Text half is centered: H2, a device select and a button that is disabled until a device is chosen, then italic consent copy and a Terms and Conditions link
visualCharacteristics.notes: All picker strings come from the authored content, so the Spanish page works unchanged. The source's SMS phone-number step is intentionally not implemented; choosing a device and pressing the button opens that device's app link. Select chevron, red pill button and colors are design-pass details. The red separator rule above the section is a section style, not part of the block.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells. Text cell: H2; optional placeholder paragraph (e.g. 'Select your device'); a bulleted list of device links (iPhone, Android) whose text is the option label and href the app link (a list item without a link may also serve as the placeholder); a paragraph with the button label (e.g. bold 'Get the app'); italic consent paragraph; Terms and Conditions link. Image cell: one picture (QR code and phone). Without the button-label paragraph the device links render as a plain link list
rows: H2, placeholder paragraph, list of device links, button label paragraph, consent copy, Terms link

usage.description: Mobile app download panel at the end of debit card promotion pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for an app-download panel with a device picker beside a QR image. For a plain text-plus-photo promo card use columns-media-card; for simple side-by-side content use columns.
